sloka: त्वं हि लोकगतिर्देव न त्वां केचित्प्रजानते ।ऋते मायां विशालाक्षीं तव पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् ।त्वामचिन्त्यं महद्भूतमक्षयं सर्वसङ्ग्रहम् ।। ७.११०.१० ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ hi lokagatirdeva na tvāṁ kecitprajānate ।ṛte māyāṁ viśālākṣīṁ tava pūrvaparigrahām ।tvāmacintyaṁ mahadbhūtamakṣayaṁ sarvasaṅgraham ।। 7.110.10 ॥

translations.english: O God, you are indeed the refuge of the worlds, and no one truly knows you, except for your previously accepted wide-eyed Maya, who knows you as the inconceivable, great, imperishable being, the container of all.
